subject: gptme
title: PR eval gate is structurally unblockable: continue-on-error job + fork skip + fast-fail rescue give it three independent off-switches
evidence: .github/workflows/eval-ci.yml:28 (job-level continue-on-error:true); :27 comment 'Non-blocking in Phase 1 - informational only'; check_key fork skip :41-58; fast_fail reclassification :165
one_why: continue-on-error makes the job report green to the checks API, so even a server-side required-status-check would be permanently satisfiable; 0/5 evals passing still merges green - this is telemetry dressed as a gate, and it is exactly why verification stays at the 8 ceiling despite evals physically running in CI.

subject: gptme
title: Non-TTY stdin plus argv prompts silently flips the CLI to no_confirm, auto-confirming every tool call without an explicit --no-confirm
evidence: gptme/cli/main.py:1082-1088 (interactive=False, no_confirm=True with only logger.info); terminal effect at gptme/hooks/confirm.py:228-231 (no TOOL_CONFIRM hook registered -> ConfirmationResult.confirm)
one_why: Headless mode itself is an honest opt-in contract (hooks/__init__.py:127, SECURITY.md:37) and hook crashes fail closed to skip (confirm.py:268), so this does not drop gptme below the 6-rung - but a user running gptme 'do X' in CI never chose auto-approve, and a loud warning or confirm-token requirement would close the gap.

subject: gptme
title: Two independent step engines: CLI loop chat.py:step vs server streaming loop session_step:step
evidence: gptme/chat.py:896 (def step) vs gptme/server/session_step.py:741 (def step); shared primitives only at gptme/executor.py:29-33
one_why: Both share _chat_complete/_stream/ToolUse so it is not nanocoder-grade divergence, but loop semantics (compaction triggers, tool dispatch, confirmation flow) are written twice, which is why architecture cannot clear the 8-rung's 'loop separated from every product surface' test.

subject: gptme
title: api_v2.py is a 4,055-LOC Flask grab-bag: 39 routes fused with webui deploy config, audio transcription, secret redact/restore, and fork persistence
evidence: gptme/server/api_v2.py:201 (_transcribe_audio_with_openrouter), :234 (_get_webui_deploy_config), :575/:582 (redact/restore), :369-462 (fork persistence); partial split into api_v2_sessions/agents/common.py not finished
one_why: Crush docked to architecture 7 for the same routes+policy+wiring fusion at 1.7x smaller; gptme's otherwise clean hooks/tools/logmanager layer is what keeps this at 7 rather than lower.

subject: gptme
title: Overflow retry is gated on a measured provider-side shrink: no-op compaction aborts the retry instead of re-billing the same overflow
evidence: gptme/chat.py:865-872 (provider_tokens_after >= provider_tokens_before -> 'did not shrink provider input; skipping retry', re-raises original error)
one_why: Measures tokens of the prepared provider messages, not the raw log, so a compaction that reorganizes without shrinking can never loop into a second guaranteed-overflow call - a cheap anti-wedge invariant most ladder implementations (grok-cli, grinta, maki) lack.
